eps.o: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. These stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.
When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.
Kitty is staying over at the Batcave for a sleepover, but getting her to lie down for a catnap is no easy task.
When Redbird takes one of Buff's stuffed animals without asking, Red enlists Bam to help him make a daring rescue.
When Bam is covered in Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage.
Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he's tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.
Batwing and Goldie secretly decide to participate in the Gotham Air-Show, but when Batman needs their help, they must choose between winning the competition and their responsibilities to fight crime.

Grundy, a giant monster truck, causes chaos as he stomps around Gotham and creates a mess. He's too powerful for the Batwheels to stop, but Buff finds a friendly solution to end the city shaking shenanigans.
When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!
To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!
When the Legion of Zoom gains control of the Batcave's giant T-Rex, MOE creates a giant Bat-robot to stop the marauding dinosaur.
Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum's famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.
Gotham's annual dog show is tonight, and Harley plans to compete for the prized "Best in Show" ribbon.
Bam must lead a new super vehicle team after the Legion of Zoom traps the rest of the Batwheels in the Batcave.

eps.t: Save the Bat Dance for Me
eps.o: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but it's up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.
After Nightbike reveals that he's afraid of loud noises, the Batwheels help him overcome his fear.
Feeling insecure about his size after a game of Hide-and-Seek, Buff uses the shrink belt belonging to The Atom.
Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight.
On Halloween Night, Poison Ivy brings all the pumpkins to life, creating an army of Snack-O-Lanterns that are eating all the candy.
Bibi enters the world of The Wizard of Oz, where she meets familiar vehicle friends and goes on an amazing quest to see the wizard himself!
When Santa's sleigh is damaged, the Batwheels must help Santa deliver presents to the children of Gotham.
With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree.
Music Meister steals the singing voices of all the people in Gotham, and bashful Buff must gain the confidence in his own voice.
When Batwing's favorite Bat-Net gets ripped during a chase with Riddler, she must learn to let go of her old net.
Clayface, Gotham City's messiest villain, arrives to cause trouble during Gotham's annual Clean Up Day.
Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him!
Bibi just can't put down her new exciting video game, even when MOE needs her help packing Bam's utility belt for a mission.
Buff tries to show Batwing how great it is to volunteer to help Gotham's needy, but the Legion of Zoom gets in the way.
Condiment King takes advantage of no Batwheels being on patrol to unleash a barrage of ketchup and mustard on an unsuspecting Gotham.
When King Tut steals an ancient artifact that makes his Carcophagus magically fast, MOE equips Bam with rocket boosters to catch the villain.
Now that Catwoman has equipped Kitty with wings, Batwing tries to teach the easily-distracted Kitty how to fly.
When Harley Quinn's Hyena goes missing, Bibi agrees to help Jestah look for her.
A sneaky trick strands the Batwheels at the docks, clearing the way for a Batcave heist by the Legion of Zoom.
Bibi and Batwing must work together to get past the Legion of Zoom in order to deliver a new giant screen to Batcomputer.
The Batwheels take on a new vehicular villain who keeps growing bigger and bigger while learning that size doesn't always win the day.
While Green Lantern is having his spaceship repaired in the Batcave, the Batwheels want to play with his adorable alien pet.
When Poison Ivy uses a rare pollen-spewing flower to put all of Gotham to sleep, it's up to Bibi to save her friends and save the day.
